import csv, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/logos/artifacts/theorem_verification_data.csv')))[1:]
alpha = [float(r[0]) for r in rows]
ethic = [float(r[1]) for r in rows]
entropy = [e / max(ethic) for e in ethic]
plt.scatter(alpha, ethic, c=entropy, cmap='cividis')
plt.xlabel('alpha'); plt.ylabel('ethic_score'); plt.colorbar(label='entropy')
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/theorem_ultimate_inquirer.png')
print('Theorem-inquirer generated.')
